scope: Independent integrated Release Guide, migration, ES Editions, Cloud environment, About/source compendium, Observability, Universal and Heavy Forwarders, SOAR and AI Availability audit; exact source mappings, legacy/current/invalid routes, reports, WebMCP and publication parity.

inventory.qualification: Every registered exact URL was requested independently during this audit. Retrieval is not claim verification. The same historical Enterprise 8.1.14 and 8.2.12 docs.splunk.com bodies returned 403 and remain unavailable without adjacent-source substitution.

claimChecks.productVersionEnvironment: Splunk Cloud Platform 10.6 current managed service
claimChecks.section: Current Splunk Cloud Platform and premium app versions; Supported forwarder versions
claimChecks.qualification: The current service table lists Cloud 10.6, ES 8.7 and ITSI 5.0. Forwarder rows apply to the tier communicating directly with Cloud; they do not establish historical availability, entitlement, rollout or customer authorization.

The table lists ES 8.4.1 through 8.7.x and ITSI 4.21.x/5.0.x for the documented rows while separately qualifying 10.6.1.1 and higher and the cohosted KV Store incompatibility for ES 8.7 and lower. The footnote is not generalized to an unlisted patch or product version.

claimChecks.section: Splunk Core Products; Splunk Universal Forwarder current version tables
claimChecks.qualification: Explicit Enterprise deadlines remain separate from Cloud and the guide's 180-day reminder. Universal Forwarder full-support and subsequent P3 windows remain distinct.

claimChecks.section: Default Version; Platform Version; CIM Version
claimChecks.qualification: The listing remains 5.4.11 with the displayed Enterprise 9.1 through 10.6 and CIM 5.x/6.x/8.x ranges. This does not prescribe a migration approach or establish app readiness.

claimChecks.productVersionEnvironment: Splunk Observability Cloud October 2026 and customer-managed instrumentation
claimChecks.qualification: The rolling service page includes the October 26 multi-trace comparison milestone and retains Controlled Availability boundaries for October 21 items. Java instrumentation 2.33.1 remains a separate customer-managed patch, not a SaaS rollout or entitlement fact.

claimChecks.productVersionEnvironment: All 18 borrowed Heavy Forwarder technical/runtime records
claimChecks.section: All stable claim IDs, exact official URLs and supporting sections
claimChecks.qualification: The actual 900-route traversal and semantic negative fixtures retain all 18 mappings, including inherited historical runtimes. This audit does not advance unchanged claim dates or broaden Enterprise-package evidence to Universal Forwarders.

The section says 8.8.0 was released for Controlled Availability and then calls the enhancement list a General Availability release. Both statements remain visible; no tenant rollout, entitlement, region, authorization, on-premises 8.8 or pairing is inferred.

claimChecks.section: September 22 build 243 correction; Python 3.9 end of support
claimChecks.qualification: Build 243 corrects the two documented build 232 defects and Python 3.13-compatible automations remain required. Conditional OS/PostgreSQL bridges and privileged conversion paths remain separate.

The FIPS-enabled repair maps affected Export versions to 8.6.1/8.7.1. The exact Enterprise/Cloud Export matrix remains separate from App for SOAR, SOAR server releases, tenant rollout and security patch floors.

claimChecks.productVersionEnvironment: Ten named AI capabilities across SAIA, ITSI, ES and Observability
claimChecks.qualification: Ten capabilities retain distinct product identity, documentation version, stage, edition, deployment, dependency, provider/region, entitlement, enablement and authorization fields. ITSI remains 5.0+, SAIA 2.2+ and MCP Server 1.2.1+; base-assistant regional evidence does not establish subagent rollout.

claimChecks.section: 205 persistent exact-URL records; Eastern schedule disclosure
claimChecks.qualification: The persistent register retains exact URL/section scope and retired history. The About schedule remains Release 05:00, ES 06:00, CSP 07:00 and Guidance Monday/Thursday 08:00 Eastern.

preservedUnknowns: The two historical Enterprise 8.1.14 and 8.2.12 source bodies remain unavailable; adjacent releases are not substituted.
SOAR issue-table retrieval gaps remain unavailable, not empty.
SOAR Cloud 8.8 Controlled Availability versus General Availability wording remains a documented conflict.
The KV-specific 10.2 bridge versus the general direct 10.0-to-10.6 route remains unresolved.
SVD-2026-1015 remains Under Investigation without affected/fixed product versions or a patch floor.
FR-H SOAR, ITSI subagent regional rollout and additional CMP agent regional scope remain not established.
Current Cloud service evidence is not retrospective release availability or customer authorization.

changes.detail: Recorded the completed bounded audit without advancing factual, lifecycle or material-cycle dates.
